wins: Completed a baseline reconnaissance sweep that successfully cataloged exposed services on the target network.
Maintained consistent agent stability through 10 mentor interactions without crashes, enabling uninterrupted training signaling.
fails: No episodes reached completion; the agent repeatedly stalled when attempting to transition from enumeration to exploitation after service discovery.
Privilege escalation attempts stalled due to inadequate lateral movement planning and missing share credential extraction.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase is solid but the agent consistently fails to translate discovered services into viable exploitation and lateral movement actions, resulting in zero successful episodes.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent fails to progress from service enumeration to exploitation, dropping momentum after steady recon.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates Linux server
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts and attempt password brute force against reused credentials

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service presents interesting version info and lacks WAF headers
skill_cards.then_action: Chain HTTP enumeration with DirBuster and CMS-specific vulnerability checks

skill_cards.if_condition: After successful credential capture during recon
skill_cards.then_action: Attempt lateral movement by listing reachable network shares and scheduling remote command execution

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in capturing initial SSH info during reconnaissance phase
Consistent HTTP enumeration provides actionable targets for follow-on exploitation attempts
